items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Basie's career, publicity, and timeline relative to other bands (Andy Kirk, Benny Moten) but does not mention a direct personal or professional interaction with Basie himself.

ctx.x: Basie ended up with Benny Goodman and John Hammond behind him--
Well, that's the point, isn't it?
